content:
Maya: FYI saw oscillation on /v1/complete where auto-fallback toggled rwd-8 <-> rwd-8-quant five times. users saw 502s. Suggest a per-route "stabilize hold" that blocks automated swaps for a short window (default 30s). Agree?

Kevin: +1. Need semantics: fixed vs exponential vs circuit (open/half-open). Prefer half-open probe: after window allow a probe request. Also dedupe same-pair flips.

Tara: Console needs a subtle amber chip: "Stabilize hold: 00:24" with actions: Extend / Force swap (reason required). Force opens modal, requires rationale + opt-in notify. Show last 10 swap events.

Eli: Infra plan: store `hold_until` and `swap_attempts` on decision record. Proto ideas: `hold_ms`, `probe_after_ms`, `sample_during_hold_pct`. Emit events: `stabilize.hold_started`, `stabilize.hold_forced`.

Maya: Telemetry: sample detailed traces during holds at very low rate (0.5%). Add metrics: `stabilize.hold_count`, `stabilize.flap_rate`. Audit all operator overrides with actor and reason.

Kevin: Tests: e2e harness that replays jittery 5xx spikes and asserts only one automated swap per hold and that probe behavior works. Unit tests for dedupe logic.

Tara: Microcopy: avoid "lockout". Tooltip: "Temporarily prevents automated model changes after a recent swap to reduce instability." Modal copy will show recent decision trace link.

Eli: API: decision-service should return `stabilize_state:{active:true,remaining_ms:24000,cause:"p95_latency"}` so console/private plane can surface it. Add sandbox flag `simulate-stabilize`.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled -> `stabilize-hold-v1` -> 5% traffic 2025-11-12T14:00Z. Watch metrics: `stabilize.hold_count`, `fallbacks_per_min`, `model_swap_latency`.

Maya: I'll draft RFC covering policy shape, UI mocks, telemetry, and tests. Sync Fri 09:30 infra/design/qa.
